symptoms.question: Do you hear knocking noises from the engine when driving or accelerating? (yes/no)
Is the oil pressure warning light on? (yes/no)
Do you see blue smoke from the exhaust? (yes/no)
Does the engine overheat or does the temperature gauge go close to the red zone? (yes/no)

rules.diagnosis: Oil pressure warning light suggests low oil pressure or oil supply problem.
rules.advice: Stop driving as soon as safely possible and check oil level. Continuing to drive may cause severe engine damage.

rules.diagnosis: Knocking noises can indicate serious engine mechanical issues (e.g., bearing wear or detonation).
rules.advice: Avoid driving and have the engine inspected by a mechanic soon to prevent further damage.

rules.diagnosis: Blue smoke often indicates oil burning (e.g., worn seals or piston rings).
rules.advice: Check oil level regularly and book a garage inspection. Prolonged driving may worsen the issue.

rules.diagnosis: Overheating can be caused by cooling system failure or coolant loss.
rules.advice: Stop driving, let the engine cool down, and check coolant level if safe. Seek assistance to avoid engine damage.
